content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Today I attempted to connect a PT1000 sensor to a recently acquired [product_name] module. My setup has run on a [product_name] base module for several months. After installation, the power supply status is OK (green light on) for the [product_name] module. When I check using the control panel of the base module, I see two analog inputs detected. Main module is [product_name] [article_no]. Everything seemed fine until I encountered an issue with the sensor connection. After some troubleshooting, I checked the [product_name] module and found something odd: when measuring voltage, there’s no power between terminal U1- and U1+. Same issue between terminal U2- and U2+. Did I overlook something needed to get 24 volts between these terminals? Can anyone assist? Thanks a lot. Regards

Why are you trying to measure voltage between the U- and U+ terminals? There isn’t a fixed voltage there, especially not 24VDC. The module sends a small, constant current through the connected PT sensor. This creates a voltage drop at the sensor, which the module evaluates to determine its resistance value (including the cable), then calculates temperature based on this resistance. Are you facing any issues? Are values missing or incorrect? Are you unsure about wiring the PT sensor?
My mistake—I’m not sure why I thought U- and U+ would show 24VDC. I’ve now connected my probe using two-wire cabling and have short-circuited terminals U1- and IC1. Thanks.
Is everything working now? Has your issue been resolved?

analysis.insight_summary: The user was confused about the expected voltage across the sensor terminals of a [product_name] module, incorrectly assuming 24V would be present. After discussion, the user learned the module operates differently, sending a small current through the sensor for resistance-based measurement. The thread highlights common misconceptions for first-time installers regarding wiring and expected electrical behavior. The matter was cleared up with support from the forum.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated finding 24VDC across the sensor terminals and sought clearer instructions on proper sensor wiring and what electrical behavior to expect when installing the [product_name] module.
